about.title: About Retold
about.subtitle: Where your technical story comes to life.
about.description: Retold was born from the need to showcase more than just repositories. We wanted to create a space where developers could tell the story behind every line of code, highlighting their technical, architectural, and creative vision.

creators.title: The Creators
creators.subtitle: Meet the team behind the platform.

mario.bio: The architect and technical lead who kickstarted Retold. As a Full-stack Engineer, he merged product vision with flawless technical execution, defining the platform's foundation. Critical architectural decisions and leadership during the project's early miles were his focus, ensuring Retold went beyond an MVP to deliver a premium experience from day one.

lucas.bio: The engine that powered Retold's development. Working across the entire stack, he transformed complex logic into fluid features. In perfect sync with Mario, he was a key player in scaling the platform, ensuring backend robustness and a reactive interface that delights the user.

joao.bio: The soul of Retold. His product vision and UI/UX expertise defined the platform's identity. Working closely with marketing, he ensures Retold isn't just an amazing tool, but a product people love and use, shaping the user journey from the first to the last click.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Understand how Retold collects, uses, and protects your personal information and our advertising policies.
privacy.collection_text: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, update your profile, or communicate with us. This may include your name, email address, profile picture, and project information.
privacy.usage_text: We use the collected information to:
usage_list: Provide, maintain, and improve our services;
Process transactions and send related notices;
Respond to your comments, questions, and requests;
Monitor and analyze trends, usage, and activities in connection with our services.
privacy.sharing_text: We do not sell your personal information. We may share aggregated or non-personally identifiable information with partners or third parties for research, analysis, or marketing purposes.
privacy.private_repos_text: When analyzing private repositories, Retold does not expose the repository URL or sensitive metadata (such as exact commit dates) publicly on your profile. Only the AI-generated technical report and summary will be visible if you choose to publish the project.
privacy.ads_text: Retold is committed to transparency regarding advertising on our platform.

ads_list.title: Third-Party Ads:
ads_list.text: We may display third-party advertisements and use cookies or other tracking technologies to deliver relevant ads based on your interests.

ads_list.title: User Data:
ads_list.text: We do not share your personally identifiable information (such as name or email) with advertisers without your explicit consent.

ads_list.title: Control:
ads_list.text: You can adjust your browser settings to refuse cookies, which may limit the personalization of the ads you see.

ads_list.title: Ad Partners:
ads_list.text: We work with trusted advertising partners who adhere to industry standards for privacy and data protection.

privacy.security_text: We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information from loss, theft, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction. However, no security system is impenetrable, and we cannot guarantee the security of our systems.
privacy.contact_text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us via our support email.
privacy.ai_processing_text: To provide our technical analyses, we use large language model providers (such as OpenAI or Google). Repository metadata and structural code snippets may be processed by these services. We do not use your code data to train models without your explicit consent.
privacy.lgpd_rights_text: Depending on your location, you have the right to: (a) Access your personal data; (b) Correct inaccuracies; (c) Request deletion; (d) Withdraw consent at any time via your account settings.
privacy.cookies_text: We use essential cookies for Retold's operation, including: (a) Authentication and Security; (b) Language Preferences; and (c) Session Processing. These cookies are necessary to protect your account and provide the requested service.

project.title: Smart code analysis
project.subtitle: Retold analyzes your GitHub repository and generates a complete technical report: executive summary, detected tech stack, architecture, and improvement suggestions.

mock_content.what_it_does_text: The project is a pedagogical simulator designed to demonstrate processor scheduling algorithms (FIFO, SJF, and Round-Robin) in an interactive web interface.
mock_content.strength_1_text: Transforms abstract theory into intuitive visual diagrams.
mock_content.strength_2_text: Contains solid implementations of core schedulers.
mock_content.architecture_text: React-based frontend application (Next.js) running entirely client-side. Separate components handle process queues and the Gantt chart.
